reviews.comment: I took him in tech skills, only had several projects that made up his grade, but it was easy. They were video projects and as long as you try to be creative, you'll get an A. He's very caring and funny! Only thing is that we had tons of free time, I actually kind of wish we had more assignments because I wanted to learn more about designing online
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anthony is the best professor!! He is so chill and you can tell he genuinely cares about his students. If you have the opportunity to take him, do it!
He was really nice and always willing to help if needed. I would definitely take him if you need to take this class

Mr. Ramirez is one of the best professors I've had at A&M. I wish more professors cared about their students well being and what they learn, as much as Mr. Ramirez does every class. he shows up with the enthusiasm and a good attitude every day. I wish I could take him again. don't take notes! just pay attention to the exam review for an A.

He was a really easy professor but LOTS of group work so get ready to pick up everyone's slack. doesn't post powerpoints so you have to show up. DON'T buy the book. waste of 35 bucks. his powerpoints consist of the important parts of the book and he tests straight from his lectures. easy A with minimal effort. funny prof but could sometimes be rude
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Mr. Ramirez is the easiest COMM prof I have taken at TAMU. Taught straight from the book, so just read powerpoints word for word. Tests were insanely easy. We did "group work" in class but he didn't grade participation. We did Kahoots before the tests that were exactly like the exams.
